end.summary:
Practised examples of diversity in language, food, dress and festivals across India.
Discussed shared values, shared celebrations and epics retold in different languages.
Compared festivals and foods using a Venn diagram; the difference and overlap were later clarified.
Explained that diversity adds variety while shared participation creates unity.
Teach-back was not completed successfully.
end.parentNote: Riya practised giving examples of regional diversity and comparing two festivals or foods using a Venn diagram. They used the method of identifying one difference and one shared feature; an initial mix-up about the overlap was corrected later by noting that people may celebrate different festivals but still come together. At home, ask them to compare two familiar festivals in three parts: same, different, and why both can be enjoyed together.
